info.title: AgentMesh
info.description: Executable backend contract. Per-operation error codes and conditional optional features are documented in backend release/expansion documents. Integers representing nano-CNY are <=2^52. TLS verification required. No automatic client retry of billable requests.

servers.description: isolated local acceptance; configure verified HTTPS for production

adminBearer.description: Independent administrator token; tenant application API keys are never accepted.

max_completion_tokens.description: Alias for max_tokens; conflicting values rejected.

Message.description: Content required except assistant tool_calls; null only for assistant calls. Tool messages require matching preceding tool_call_id. No pending calls at end.

arguments.description: Complete JSON object encoded as a string; paired tool result required in request history.

parameters.description: Object JSON Schema, at most 32 KiB; total admission bound includes tool definitions.

output_config.description: effort accepted but unsupported on fixed non-thinking model; response header marks this. format rejected.

metadata.description: Accepted as client metadata; never trusted as identity.

KeyInfo.description: Metadata only, never raw key or digest

reference.description: Private agentmesh://images/{id}; resolved only for the authenticated tenant before provider admission.

post.description: Authenticated embeddings; at most 32 inputs, split into upstream batches of 20. Optional CNY billing records actual input usage per batch; unknown usage retains a pending reconciliation hold. Cloud semantic-cache embeddings use the same wallet. No automatic retries.
